title: Downlink Starvation in Shared LoRaWAN Cells: Simulator and Experiments
description: Discrete-event simulator of shared EU868 LoRaWAN cells, experiment scripts and raw results for the paper "Downlink Starvation in Shared LoRaWAN Cells: Attacks by Authenticated Devices and Per-Tenant Downlink Budgets". It shows how one device with valid keys that obeys the duty cycle can use up a shared gateway's downlink budget, and compares network-server policies against it, including a per-tenant downlink budget with a standalone reference implementation. All results come from simulation.
